questions.subject: BUSINESS_ENTREPRENEURSHIP
questions.stem: Maplepeak sets the price of its accounting software and offers seasonal discounts. Which element of the marketing mix is this?

questions.explanation: The marketing mix comprises product, price, place, and promotion. Setting a price and offering discounts are price decisions, even though discounts can also support promotion; the core variable being set here is price.
